Mediators propose 10-day ceasefire to revive Iran-US interim deal

Mediators have put forward a 10-day ceasefire proposal aimed at reviving an interim peace deal between Iran and the United States. The proposal was reportedly conveyed to Iran by mediators. This development suggests ongoing diplomatic efforts to de-escalate tensions and potentially re-engage in negotiations.
